description:
Turn your Photos & Art into Custom Trading Cards 


Whether you’re printing a rookie’s first baseball card, collectible fan cards, or a limited-edition set for your brand, UPrinting turns your design into a card people are proud to hold. Choose premium 14pt or 16pt cardstock, add gloss, matte, soft-touch, or eye-catching foil and holographic finishes.

Every file gets a free expert review before it prints, so your colors stay vivid and your cards come out exactly as you imagined. From 25 cards to 10,000 — designed online or from your own artwork and shipped as fast as one business day. 


Customization Options: Cardstocks, Finishes & Foil 


Make your own trading cards by printing on the front, back or both sides of your new keepsake. Mix and match stock, finish, foil, and shape — then preview it in our online design tool or upload print-ready artwork.  Available in 2.5” x 3.5” standard size — the classic collectible shape with optional 1/4" rounded corners for a softer, retail-card look.


Cardstock Paper Types

Choose which cardstock suits your custom deck. Both 14pt and 16pt Cardstock weights are thick enough to shuffle and collect, with 16 pt. being durable enough to resist bends and creases.

Create a Collectible with Foil & Specialty Embellishments



Give your trading cards a limited-edition feel by adding metallic or holographic shine with Raised Foil (dimensional, textured) or Foil Stamping (smooth, flat) on the front, back, or both sides.  

Colors: gold, silver, copper, red, blue, black, plus raised gold, silver, and holographic.  

Foil File-Setup Guidelines 

   • Use 12pt or larger font for any text in foil.
   • Avoid very thin fonts or tight letter spacing.
   • Foil strokes/borders should be thicker than 1.5pt.
   • Keep foil coverage to about 50% of the surface, with elements at least 1/16" apart.
   • Need help? Our team can set it up — call 888-888-4211 or request free file review.


Printing a big run, a full set, or need custom packaging? From multi-design series to thousands of cards — plus card boxes, packs, and binders — our team will build a custom quote around your project. Request a custom quote


Frequently Asked Questions 

Screens emit light, so prints can look slightly darker. For the most accurate color, design in CMYK, avoid very dark backgrounds if you want detail to show, and keep blacks rich (not muddy). Every order gets a free expert file review, and you can order a printed sample to check color before a big run.

Start from our free trading card print layout template. Extend your background to the bleed line, keep important text and faces inside the safe zone, and upload at 300 DPI. Our team reviews every file before printing and will flag anything that could shift in cutting.

Gloss makes color pop (great for photos and sports cards); Matte is elegant and easy to sign; Soft-Touch and Silk feel premium. Raised foil adds dimensional metallic or holographic shine. For a classic collectible look, 16pt + Gloss is a popular, pro-quality choice; add gold or holographic foil for a true premium card. 

The standard trading-card size is 2.5" × 3.5" (the same as classic sports and gaming cards).

UPrinting prints this collectible size with an optional 1/4" rounded-corner finish. 

You can order as few as 25 cards and scale to 10,000, so it works for a single gift or a full production run. Use the instant price calculator to see pricing for your exact stock, finish, and quantity. 

Custom trading card printing turnaround is 1–6 business days depending on options, not counting shipping, weekends, or holidays. Choose 1- or 2-day turnaround when you’re on a deadline. 

Both work. Design from a free template in our online tool — add photos, text, and stats in minutes — or upload finished artwork from Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva. Want a pro to set it up? Our Design Services team can help.
